cases.summary: VAVAVA Shop collaborated with Fatboy Slim on a Mexico City pop-up (29-31 Oct 2024) selling tees, hoodies and patches designed for Mexican fans ahead of his 1 Nov show at Pepsi Center.
Mercadorama and Faramalla Club de Vinilos partnered with Interpol on a 18-20 April 2024 pop-up at Vavava Shop with exclusive merch, posters and vinyl commemorating the band's Zocalo show.
Matador Records ran a 9-14 November 2024 pop-up at Vavava Shop in Mexico City with label merch and vinyl from Water From Your Eyes and others ahead of Corona Capital, plus a band meet and greet.
Turnstile's 12 September 2026 show at Woodbine Park in Toronto was announced with Yves Tumor, Saya Gray and Pluto's Kiss as guests, part of a tour with a curated guest lineup per city.
Mexican musician Erik Rubin was among the guests who joined Ca7riel & Paco Amoroso on stage at their Palacio de los Deportes show in Mexico City on the Free Spirits World Tour.
Brew York launched a limited-edition pale ale, Homecoming, with York band Shed Seven tied to their 19-20 July 2024 shows at York Museum Gardens.
At her 7 November 2025 Buenos Aires show Dua Lipa covered Argentine rock band Soda Stereo's De Musica Ligera as that stop's local-artist tribute.
At her 11 November 2025 Santiago show Dua Lipa covered Chilean singer Mon Laferte's Tu Falta de Querer.
At her 28 November 2025 Bogota show Dua Lipa covered Colombian singer Shakira's Antologia.
During her December 2025 Estadio GNP Seguros run in Mexico City Dua Lipa performed Oye Mi Amor with Fher Olvera of Mexican rock band Mana.
Metallica covered Mexican band El Tri's A.D.O. at Estadio GNP Seguros in Mexico City on 27 September 2024.
Metallica covered La Sonora Santanera's Los Luchadores, with luchadores on stage, at Estadio GNP Seguros in Mexico City on 29 September 2024.
Tijuana-born singer Julieta Venegas joined Bad Bunny on stage at Estadio GNP Seguros in Mexico City on 19 December 2025 for three songs.
Adidas released a Mexico-exclusive Bad Bunny tee carrying the tour seal and the city name for his December 2025 Mexico City stadium run.

runs.methodNote: Local acts: city-popular artists re-ranked by taste fit (qloo_rank). Judged on fresh cases reviewed after the method was fixed.

cases.summary: Brazilian singer Milton Nascimento joined Coldplay at their Rio de Janeiro stadium show to sing Maria, Maria.
Caetano Veloso joined Dua Lipa on stage at MorumBIS in São Paulo to perform Margarida Perfumada.
Brazilian percussionist Carlinhos Brown joined Dua Lipa at her São Paulo show and sang Magalenha, a Sérgio Mendes song.
Australian singer Vanessa Amorosi made a surprise appearance at G Flip's Melbourne show at Margaret Court Arena, performing Absolutely Everybody.
Olivia Rodrigo covered Irish band Fontaines D.C.'s I Love You at her Marlay Park show in Dublin.
Hayley Williams covered Irish artist Sinéad O'Connor's Mandinka at the second of two Dublin National Stadium shows, dedicating it to Irish artists.
Fher Olvera of Guadalajara band Maná joined Coldplay in the final encore at Estadio Akron to perform Rayando el Sol.
Toronto's Drake made a surprise appearance at 21 Savage's Budweiser Stage show, performing On BS and Rich Flex.
Brazilian singer Anitta appeared during Vogue at Madonna's free Copacabana show in Rio de Janeiro.
Brazilian artist Pabllo Vittar joined Madonna for Music with samba school percussionists at the Copacabana show in Rio de Janeiro.
Colombian artist Manuel Turizo joined Coldplay at El Campín in Bogotá to perform La Bachata with Chris Martin on piano.
Coldplay performed a reimagined cover of La Canción, by Colombian artist J Balvin and Bad Bunny, at their Bogotá show.
Canadian singer Bryan Adams joined Coldplay in Vancouver as a surprise guest to perform (Everything I Do) I Do It For You.

amendments.summary: The first eligible list had two design flaws.
The candidate rule leaked who played into who was added.

tests.title: Test A: choosing the cities a tour played
tests.question: Does winnability pick the cities a tour actually played better than fan heat alone, a generic LLM, or population?
tests.status: Complete: 3 of a planned 4 artists scored
claims: Test A (city ranking) covers 3 of a planned 4 artists.
Mean R-precision: winnability 0.50, fan heat 0.58, the generic LLM 0.75, population 0.67; mean chance level 0.40.
Not significant at this sample size: winnability trails fan heat on mean R-precision (0.50 vs 0.58; p=0.500; 0 wins, 2 losses, 1 tie over 3 artists).
Not significant at this sample size: winnability trails the generic LLM on mean R-precision (0.50 vs 0.75; p=0.250; 0 wins, 3 losses over 3 artists).
The generic LLM beat winnability for Synthetic Quartet.
limits: Data timing: the taste data is current, not as of the tour date.
Sample size: a few artists is a small sample, so the sign test has low power.

tests.title: Test B: picking the real activation among 10 candidates
tests.question: For the reviewed activation cases, does Qloo rank place the real pick higher among 10 candidates than Gemini or popularity?
tests.status: Complete: 3 of 4 cases scored. An earlier run stopped on an infrastructure failure and is kept below.
claims: Test B (fixed candidates) covers 3 of 4 cases.
Not significant at this sample size: Qloo rank trails Gemini on mean reciprocal rank (0.61 vs 0.67; p=1.000; 0 wins, 1 loss, 2 ties over 3 cases).
Not significant at this sample size: Qloo rank leads popularity on mean reciprocal rank (0.61 vs 0.14; p=0.250; 3 wins, 0 losses over 3 cases).
Gemini beat Qloo rank for synth-b.
limits: Each case has the real pick plus 9 decoys from the city's popularity list.

tests.title: Claim checker: does it remove planted false claims?
tests.question: When a number or a name in a playbook claim is changed to a wrong one, does the claim checker remove the claim?

rows: A number found nowhere in the evidence
A name swapped in from another card

claims: The claim checker removed 10 of 10 planted false claims (catch rate 1.00).
limits: False alarms (0 of 20) are not a finding: true claims were drawn from claims the verifier already accepted.

tests.title: Test C: do the names exist in the city?
tests.question: Do the venues, sponsor brands and local acts a playbook names really exist in the city? Qloo's playbook as shipped against an LLM-only playbook, for Synthetic Quartet.
claims: Test C (grounding) covers 2 cities for Synthetic Quartet: 36 of 40 names rated, 0 unrated, 4 marked can't tell.
Not significant at this sample size: Qloo leads the LLM-only playbook on mean share in city (0.85 vs 0.65; p=0.500; 2 wins, 0 losses over 2 cities).
limits: Disclosure: the reviewer had seen the shipped showcase playbooks for these cities.
